title: GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS
summary: General fastening practice for the whole car, with sketches: special shaft retainers, castellated nuts with cotter pins, spreading cotter pin legs, clinching wire/tube/cable clips, rivets between plastic and metal upset on the metal side, ground-wire lock washer placement, and installing 'MB' stamped nuts open end up. No specific parts.
notes: Install special retainers as shown so they load the part toward the arrow.

Castellated nut with cotter pin: torque to spec, then tighten to the next notch to insert the pin unless otherwise specified; pin may go in either position shown but must be tight (no rotation or looseness).
Cotter pin must shoulder on stud; spread each leg at least 45° from the pin centerline (45° MIN. each side).
Clinch all non-hardened steel clips closed after wires, tubes or bowden cables are installed (open vs. closed position shown).
Rivet joining plastic to metal: upset the rivet on the metal side.
Ground connections: position lock washers as shown (on nut-on-stud and bolt versions) to ensure a proper ground.
Assemble all 'MB stamped nuts' with the open end up. CAUTION: open end down strips the stud before installation torque is reached.
